To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the initial Si to Al molar ratio of the ZSM-5 seeds strongly affects the properties of the resulting mesoporous materials.
the high-temperature synthesis of ordered mesoporous aluminosilicates with improved acidic properties from zeolitic precursors can be achieved by a two-step process.

the initial Si / Al molar ratio of the ZSM-5 precursor strongly affects the textural and acidic characteristics of the final mesoporous SAB-15 type materials, and that a highly condensed, well ordered SBA-15 with improved hydrothermal and acidic properties can prepared from low aluminum ZSM-5 (Si/Al molar ratios ≥ 20).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of highly ordered mesoporous S-BA-15 type materials with improved acidic properties from ZSM- 5 nanoseeds.
the preparation of highly ordered, well-defined and stable mesoporous SAB-15 materials with improved acidic properties from low cost precursors.
the synthesis of ordered mesoporous SAB-15 analogs from ZSM- 5 nanoseeds with improved acidic properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the synthesis of highly condensed and ordered mesoporous materials with improved hydrothermal stabilities and acidic properties can indeed be achieved using ZSM-5 zeolite nanoseeds as precursors.

the synthesis of highly condensed, ordered mesoporous S-BA-15 type analogs can be achieved from low aluminum containing zeolite precursors (Si/AI ≥ 20), whereas the synthesis of a disordered material is observed when the aluminum content of the precursors is increased.

a high degree of condensation of the zeolite building blocks in the SBA- 15 type mesopore walls, as a result of a low aluminum content, is the main reason for the improved hydrothermal stability of these mesoporous SAB-15 analogs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of ZSM- 5 nanoseeds as precursors is a promising strategy to prepare mesoporous aluminosilicate materials with improved acidic properties and enhanced hydrothermal stability.

the high-temperature synthesis of ordered mesoporous aluminosilicates with improved acidic properties is possible by using ZSM-5 as nanoseed, however, only when the initial ZSM-5 precursor has a low aluminum content.

the synthesis of ordered mesoporous SAB-15 analogs by using ZSM-5 as nanoseeds at a high temperature is an effective method to obtain highly condensed, ordered mesoporous materials with improved textural and acidic characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of mesoporous SAB-15 analogs from ZSM- 5 nanoseeds is a viable route to prepare highly ordered mesoporous materials with improved textural and acidic characteristics.

the high temperature synthesis of ordered mesoporous S-BA-15 analog materials from ZSM- 5 nanoseeds can be a useful tool to prepare highly condensed, well ordered, and stable SBA-15 materials with improved acidic properties.
the high temperature synthesis from ZSM-15 nanoseeds can be a promising route to the production of ordered mesoporous aluminosilicates with improved acidic properties.
